input.title: Give the Topic select an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The <select id="topic"> has no accessible name. The visible "Topic" label on line 11 has no for attribute, so it isn't linked to the select. I can only edit the select itself, so this adds aria-label="Topic", which matches the visible label text so speech-input users can say it. A better fix is to add for="topic" to the <label> on line 11. That would also let users click the label to focus the select. The reviewer may want to make that change instead of this one, or as well. This change should clear the label rule, but it doesn't mean the page is fully accessible.
